---
title: "All pages on this site"
listing:
  contents:
    - "*.qmd"
  exclude:
    - filename: "index"
    - filename: "Page Not Found"
  type: default
  image-align: left
  fields: [title, description, categories]
  sort:
    - "title"
    - "date"
  sort-ui: true
  filter-ui: true
  categories: true            # Show category list
  page-size: 12               # Items per page (pagination)
---

::: callout-tip
## On this page, you can browse all the pages on the site. You can use the filter to search for specific content. The table shows the title, creation date, and a brief description of each page. Click on the table headers to sort them by different criteria.
:::
